info.title: INSYS Core platform operator API
info.description: For the platform operator tenant only: tenant administration and global static data (scopes G and GT). Every response carries X-Correlation-Id: the caller's when it sent a valid one, else a new one; errors repeat it as correlationId. x-function lists the functions an operation belongs to (ADR-026): the caller needs any one of them, one per portal for an operation the portals share. Operations about the signed-in user and signed provider callbacks have none.

get.summary: List every global (platform administrators) version of a UI label and translation bundles code
get.description: Each version carries its rowVersion and no ETag header of its own. To change a version (submit, withdraw, approve, retire), send If-Match with its rowVersion in double quotes, for example If-Match: "3" for rowVersion 3: the same entity tag every INSYS ETag header uses (BR-014).

post.summary: Create a global (platform administrators) UI label and translation bundles draft
post.description: Creates version 1 of a new code, or the next version of an existing one. The caller is the maker.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

put.summary: Edit a global (platform administrators) UI label and translation bundles draft
put.description: Only the maker edits a draft; approved versions are immutable (SDM-002).

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The ETag from the last GET (row_version, DBA-011). Missing gives 428; stale gives 412.

post.summary: Submit, activate, deprecate or retire a global (platform administrators) UI label and translation bundles version
post.description: submit sends the draft for approval (approve and reject are on the same path, decided in Workflow); activate puts an approved version in force; deprecate stops new use; retire hides it (SDM-007). Completes asynchronously (GAP-027): after submit, the change request and its Workflow approval appear (GET /api/v1/static-data/change-requests, GET /api/v1/workflow/approvals); until then approve and reject return 404. Activation's cache refreshes follow too.

post.summary: Request a new tenant's two first administrators
post.description: Platform operator only, while the tenant is Onboarding and has no users. Names exactly two administrators (BR-013), so that from the start one can approve what the other does (a privileged role, a static data change); else 422 VALIDATION_FAILED on administrators. A second platform administrator approves it in Workflow (approval type TENANT_ADMINISTRATOR); a platform administrator never approves anything inside the tenant. Then the tenant's TENANT_ADMIN role (granted these functions: at least one, each a staff function in force in the catalogue, else 422 VALIDATION_FAILED on functions), both users and their active assignments are created. status is then AwaitingIdentity until both identities are linked (Provisioned), IdentityParked while one waits on Keycloak, or IdentityFailed when one needs a fix and a retry (BR-018). The ORGANISATION_AND_ACCESS step completes once both administrators are active: identity linked and at least one successful authenticated request each. With idpCode KEYCLOAK, displayName must not contain a character Keycloak's name validator refuses (< > & " $ % ! # ? § ; * ~ / \ | ^ = [ ] { } ( ) and control characters): a 422 with a field error on displayName (BR-006). Completes asynchronously (GAP-027): the TENANT_ADMINISTRATOR approval appears in Workflow; after approval the users' identities are created and linked (Provisioned), and Tenancy checks the onboarding step.
